summary: HighPeak Energy filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 disclosing two Securities Purchase Agreements for a newly created Series A 6.0% Perpetual Convertible Preferred Stock: 250,000 shares to PT Danantara Energy International and 200,000 shares to PT Tunas Harapan Perkasa, each at a $1,000 stated value, implying roughly $450 million gross. Terms include quarterly cash dividends starting at 6.0% cash/7.5% PIK, stepping to 7.5%/9.0% in year two, then 10.0%; conversion at $9.50; issuer redemption after year three at a 10% IRR; mandatory conversion if shares exceed 150% of the conversion price for thirty of forty trading days.
